top_signals.title: Joint statement by High Representative/Vice-President Kallas and Commissioner Kos on the early parliamentary elections in Serbia
top_signals.summary: European Commission Statement Brussels, 28 Oct 2026 On Sunday 25 October, the people of Serbia turned out in historic numbers to make their voices heard. Voters have given the next government a strong mandate for change. We look forward to seeing this being realised in practice.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Discord to let search engines index public server messages
top_signals.summary: Discord will allow search engines to index discussions in Discoverable Servers and make them accessible on the web to users outside the platform without an account or invitation. [...]
